name: org-standards
description: PeoplesHR organization standards for Claude Code. Ships the phx-business-context skill, which retrieves PeoplesHR module behaviour, user flows and product documentation from WeKnora in business terms, and the weknora MCP server for read-only retrieval from the PeoplesHR knowledge bases. The hrm-deployment-script, hrm-notification, phx-debugger and hrm-configuration-document skills moved to the dev-kit plugin in 3.0.0; the phx-sql-standards-review skill and the phx-dbexplorer MCP server moved to the dba-kit plugin in 4.0.0; phx-product-context moved to dev-kit in 5.0.0, which is also when phx-business-context arrived here from ba-kit.
